name: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct
definition: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct is an open-weight Qwen3 Coder model by Qwen / Alibaba focused on repository-scale coding, software agents, tool use and engineering workflows.

license.name: Apache 2.0
license.commercial_use: Review exact official terms before production.

hardware.summary: High-memory workstation or server; sparse activation lowers compute but does not shrink the stored expert set to 3.3B.

deployment.summary: Transformers and modern serving runtimes such as vLLM can serve the checkpoint.
deployment.eu_eea_self_hosting: Technically possible when the complete inference stack is operated on EU/EEA infrastructure.
deployment.data_residency: Provider origin does not determine data residency.
